Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary. Join: activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: assay.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054502', standard_value IS NOT NULL, standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
